title: uni8ank
tagline: Uni8ank is a divination tool for practitioners to stake ethereum on alchemical pathways from matter.direct light, sourcing instant futures yield using apwine and crystal recommendations for energetic stability
description: Play to earn app for oracle tools for players to earn yield based on decisional pathways chosen from a direction of 255 matter.direct library symbols, where players are recommended a crystal structure to uphold energetic forces based on Bravais group numbers. Some may not be ready, and it can create a type of decisional practice pathway, while this creates a practice playground for users (moderately) to execute on spiritual journeys.
how_its_made: The project uses a cli (with some nice colors) to be as basic as possible and prevent any internet browser malice or censorship or tracking. The project highly leverages APWine to earn yield to input the users desired pathways for which they choose. What surprised me was the live yield augmentation that was conjured based on mainnet practice. In the future other sponsor technologies will be used, but we really wanted to understand the potentialities of apwine.
